inputs.checklistItemText: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead electric utility pole
inputs.question: Are electric utility poles shown on the landscape plan (Sheet 31)? If so, are there any proposed trees (SY, PL, P, M symbols) positioned within 10 feet of any pole locations?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing a progressive verification: first checking for the presence of utility poles and proposed trees on the sheet, then asking whether trees fall within the 10-foot zone. The initial presence and identification questions are generic (feature detection); the actual 10-foot clearance measurement would come as a follow-up if trees are found near poles.
